summary: No independent human security review of the release profile has been performed. The scoped threat model, review scope and date, findings with dispositions and retest commands exist in docs/security-review-v0.1.0.md from an automated reviewer, but an automated review is not the third-party signature S1 names.
The P-series controlled-hardware measurement criteria (workload mix, durability modes, long-duration regression budgets) remain open, so performance acceptance cannot be signed.
Soak, failure and recovery evidence retention (O9) and the staging upgrade/rollback drills (O8) remain open, so recovery acceptance cannot be signed.
